params.samples: primary tumours not excluded (see 01 exclusions); males included (unsupervised)
params.main_gene_set: top 2,000 variance genes after removing the 50 PAM50 genes and sex-specific genes (chrY, XIST, TSIX)
sensitivity_gene_sets: main 2,000 plus all 50 PAM50 genes forced in
hierarchical: Ward linkage, Euclidean distance on z-scores

consensus.final_partition: average linkage on 1 - consensus, cut at k

params.k_selection_rule: pre-specified: primary k = the k in 2..8 with the lowest PAC (Senbabaoglu 2014); k = 4 (next PAC minimum) and k = 5 (Netanely 2016 used K-means K = 5 with correlation distance on the top 2,000 genes, with adjacent normals included) also reported
params.agreement: ARI and NMI against clinical group (3 classes), PanCan PAM50 without Normal-like (4 classes), TCGA 2012 SigClust clusters (13 levels) and IHC ER status; 95% CI from 1000 bootstrap resamples of tumours (seed 42). The CIs are conditional on the fitted partition (clusters are not re-fitted in each resample); clustering stability is reported separately (PAC, method and gene-set ARIs). ARI depends on the number of classes, so label-vs-label agreement is reported as a reference
params.cluster_ids: relabelled by size: C0 = largest cluster
